newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Smurfit silent on talk of Kohler buy.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit silent on talk of Kohler buy.

text.p: Irish paper and packaging manufacturer Jefferson Smurfit Group Plc declined to comment on market talk in South Africa that it was interested in acquiring Malbak packaging subsidiary Kohler Ltd.
A Smurfit spokeswoman told Reuters on Tuesday that the company did not comment on market rumours.

South African conglomerate Malbak announced further details of a planned unbundling on Monday which it said could add 15 percent in value for shareholders who are likely to receive shares in the listed companies controlled by Malbak plus a cash payment for the unlisted entities.
Malbak has invited those interested in bidding for its various investments to submit indicative offers by November 29.
Kohler, which is among Malbak's listed holdings, recently reported a pre-tax profit of 207.9 million rand for the year to August 31, up from 178.6 million a year earlier.
Earnings per share before abnormal items were 47.2 cents.
